user.title: Set up Irish Rail
user.description: Choose the station you want to monitor.

data_description.station_filter: Type the start of a word in the station's name, like the irishrail.ie search (e.g. pearse). Leave empty to browse all stations.

directions.title: Direction filter for {station}
directions.description: Only the directions Irish Rail currently reports for services at {station} are listed below.

data_description.direction: Stations on the Dundalk-Rosslare and Sligo-Dublin corridors report Northbound/Southbound; every other station reports "To Cork" values instead. The list reflects services due within the API's lookahead window, so choose All if unsure. If no trains are currently due, enter the direction exactly as shown on irishrail.ie (e.g. To Limerick) or leave All.

filter_options.title: Optional filters
filter_options.description: "{station}" is selected. Tick any filters to apply, or leave both unticked to monitor every service.

data_description.enable_direction_filter: Only monitor services towards one direction.
data_description.enable_stops_at_filter: Only monitor trains that call at a particular station en route.

stops_at.title: "Stops at" filter for {station}
stops_at.description: Only stations that the selected services actually reach after {station} are offered.

data_description.stops_at: Choose All to disable the filter. Options come from services currently due; when none can be sampled right now, recently observed stops or the bundled reference data is used instead. Only as a last resort is the full station list offered.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Irish Rail
reconfigure.description: Change the direction filter for {station}. Only the directions Irish Rail currently reports for this station are offered; the station itself cannot be changed.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Irish Rail API.
error.no_matching_stations: No stations match that filter. Leave the box empty to browse all stations.

abort.already_configured: This station with this configuration is already monitored.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Successfully reconfigured the Irish Rail entry.
abort.update_entry_failed: Failed to save the updated configuration.

init.title: Irish Rail options
init.description: Adjust polling and the "stops at" filter.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Irish Rail API, between 30 seconds and 10 minutes (default 60 seconds).
data_description.stops_at: Only show trains that stop at this station en route. Choose All to disable the filter.

empty_data_during_service_hours.title: No train data received for {station}
empty_data_during_service_hours.description: The Irish Rail API has returned no trains at this station for an extended period during service hours. This may indicate an API or schedule data change rather than a genuine quiet period. If it persists, check whether other stations still report data, then try reloading or re-adding the entry.

rebuild_stops_matrix.name: Rebuild stops at matrix
rebuild_stops_matrix.description: Rebuild the bundled "stops at" matrix by sampling every Irish Rail station in the background. The job runs to completion and reports progress and outcome in the matching button's state attributes. The service is the automation-facing alias of pressing the "Rebuild stops at matrix" button.
